title: RFdiffusion Input Parameters
description: RFdiffusion-specific parameters passed via DesignRequest.toolParams. RFdiffusion emits backbones only; sequences are added by a downstream ProteinMPNN pass (see manifest.composes).

binder_length_range.description: Min/max residue length of the designed binder backbone.

noise_scale.description: Diffusion noise scale at inference time. Lower = more conservative backbones.

inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. Lower is faster; higher is intended for smaller decision-grade campaigns.

contigs.description: Advanced override: full RFdiffusion contigmap.contigs string. When present, overrides target_chain + binder_length_range.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target in the input PDB.

num_designs.description: Backbones per seed. Mirrored at top-level DesignRequest.numDesigns.

skip_mpnn.description: If true, platform will NOT chain ProteinMPNN automatically. Adapter itself always just emits backbones.
